Text: RF6 + DC18. QD RF pins: 1, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24. SMP1-6 active; SMP7-8 signal NC.
QD/R/C Bottom. ZIF/SMP Top. R/C rotated inward; RF path passes through resistor RF pad.
QD-side stack: RF / GND / DC / GND / DC / GND. DC mapping follows physical routing.
J1 uses even contacts 2..48 only. Pin50, odd contacts and mounts52/53 are NC.
